manager.title: Extensions
manager.intro: Declarative packs (no code) that add shapes, templates, themes, stickers, palettes and composite elements. They only apply in this browser and only for you. Only install packs from people you trust.
manager.devFolderHint: For people building an extension: loads a local folder. It is marked as “dev”.
manager.policyAllowlist_one: Only {count} extension from the allowed list
manager.policyAllowlist_other: Only the {count} extensions on the allowed list
manager.safeModeHint: Turns every extension off without uninstalling anything. Handy if something looks wrong.
manager.safeModeUrl: This tab was opened with ?safe=1: extensions stay off until you open LuDraw without that parameter.
manager.safeModeActive: Safe Mode is on: all extensions are off.
manager.themeNone: Turn on a theme extension to pick it here.
manager.builtinHint: Written from scratch for LuDraw, MIT licensed, off until you turn them on.
manager.installedHint: Packs you installed from a file or folder.
manager.hashHonesty: The hash is checked on every load against the one saved at installation. It lives in the same browser storage: it protects against corrupted or accidentally changed files, not against someone who can change both. The author is self-declared (no signature). The real defense is comparing this hash with the one the author publishes.
install.title: Install “{name}”?
install.sameContent: Same content as the installed one (same hash).
install.devWarning: Local folder (development mode): only use it with extensions you’re building yourself.
install.compareHash: Compare these 12 characters with the ones the author publishes before confirming.

permissions.needApproval: Approve the extension’s permissions before turning it on.
permissions.notRequested: The extension doesn’t request this permission.
permissions.title: Requested permissions
permissions.none: None — declarative pack, doesn’t run code
permissions.boardRead: Read the open board: objects, text and the selection (hidden private notes arrive without text).
permissions.boardWrite: Create, edit and delete board objects — always within your own board permissions.
permissions.uiPanel: Show its own window over the board (the extension panel).
permissions.clipboardPaste: Receive the plain text and generic HTML you paste on the board.
permissions.filesImport: Receive the files you choose to import.
permissions.filesExport: Offer files for you to download (goes through the export permission).
permissions.storage: Keep up to 1 MB of its own data in this browser.
permissions.network: Access the internet ONLY on these domains: {hosts}
permissions.elevatedRisk: Higher risk: this extension shows its own interface AND reads the board. Only install it if you trust whoever published it.
permissions.elevatedConfirm: I understand the risk and trust this extension.
permissions.approveHint: You can revoke each permission later in the extension’s details.
panel.empty: No extension panel is on. Turn on an extension with a panel in Settings → Extensions.
panel.unavailable: This panel isn’t available: the extension was turned off or shut down.
panel.isolation: Isolated: no access to the app, the network or the browser’s storage.
